Plan edging tape for a rectangle

Enter dimensions at the tape installation line, extra joining length and length per roll. All four sides are assumed bound.

Planning result—

Enter numbers and calculate. Values stay in your browser.

Formula and limits

Perimeter = 2 × (width + length). Planned tape = perimeter + joining allowance. Rolls = ceil(planned tape ÷ length per roll).

All four sides of one rectangle only. Does not calculate tape width, fabric bulk, corner technique or joins you did not enter.
